stem: During a class trip to a pond near her school in Kerala, Meena observes tadpoles swimming in the water and an adult frog sitting on a leaf at the edge. Her teacher asks how each one breathes. Which statement correctly matches each stage of the frog to its breathing organs?

options.text: Tadpoles breathe through lungs; adult frogs breathe through gills only.
Tadpoles breathe through gills; adult frogs breathe through lungs and moist skin.
Both tadpoles and adult frogs breathe through lungs and skin.
Tadpoles breathe through skin; adult frogs breathe through gills.

teacher.key_rationale: Tadpoles, living in water, use gills; adult frogs, living on land and water, use lungs and moist skin. Option B is the only pairing that matches breathing organs to habitat and life stage.
